title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Billing Standard — Invoices, Charge Authorization, Statements and Interest
content:
## 1. Invoices and due dates

1.1 Every purchase charged to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is invoiced separately.
1.2 A commercial account invoice is due the tier's payment terms, in calendar days, after its invoice date.
1.3 A revolving account's invoices are billed together on the monthly statement, due the tier's statement due-date offset in days after the statement date.

Hypothetical example: an invoice dated 3 March on a Commercial Account Net 45 is due 45 calendar days later, on 17 April.

## 2. Purchase orders, job names and sales tax

2.1 When the account requires a purchase order number, a purchase without a purchase order number is not charged to the account.
2.2 Job names are limited to the tier's maximum number of active job names.
2.3 A purchase is invoiced tax-exempt only when a valid exemption certificate is on file for the invoice date; otherwise sales tax is charged and may later be credited back as a sales tax credit.

## 3. Charge authorization

A charge is authorized only while the account status is active and the new balance stays within the credit line plus the tier's over-limit tolerance percentage of that line. A charge is therefore not authorized on an account that is applied, on hold, closed, declined or charged off.

## 4. How each invoice was priced

Each invoice records how it was priced: at the shelf price; under a ProBuild volume pricing quote, with the quote applied referenced on the invoice; or at a contract price, for prices fixed in an installation or special order agreement.

## 5. Statements and minimum payment

5.1 A monthly account statement closes the period, fixing its balance, past-due amount and days past due.
5.2 **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause under which a revolving statement's minimum payment due was the full balance when below the tier's minimum payment floor, and otherwise the greater of that floor and the tier's minimum payment percentage of the balance, has been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for the minimum payment.
5.3 A pay-in-full statement's minimum is its full balance (a minimum payment percentage of 100).

## 6. Interest

Interest is charged only on a revolving account, on the carried balance at the tier's annual percentage rate divided by the tier's days-in-year figure per day. It is not charged when the previous statement balance was paid in full within the grace period, and it is never less than the tier's minimum interest charge when it is above zero.

Hypothetical example: computed interest of 1.40 on a Pro Revolving Charge statement is above zero and below the 2.00 minimum interest charge, so 2.00 is charged; computed interest of 0.00 leaves no charge.

superseded_clauses: A revolving statement's minimum payment due is the full balance when below min_payment_floor_usd, and otherwise the greater of min_payment_floor_usd and min_payment_pct_of_balance percent of the balance
